resources.string: JointSense estimates TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-1β from chip reaction-chamber images. Six RGB features—channel means and standard deviations—feed a factor-specific analysis model. The OA inflammation index (AI) combines the three factors into a score from 0 to 1 and maps it to grades 0 through 4.\n\nModel coefficients in this research build are placeholders pending a validated trained export.
